summary: FRD Addendum A (Signup Questionnaire Redesign, Worker Classes, Equipment Verification, Skill Reclassification) validated end-to-end. Backend: 15/15 pytest cases green — questionnaire save + skills sync (attributes NEVER leak into skills), driving/delivery vehicle gate (400 without car/truck), full carpet_cleaning claim lifecycle (incomplete → pending → returned w/ admin_note → edit re-opens to incomplete → resubmit → verified → skills sync; grace extension), licensed plumbing gate (license_number + upload required), admin trade CRUD (create/edit/delete + delete blocked when claims exist + new trade appears in /api/trades/definitions immediately), trade-claims filtering all|pending|returned|verified, metrics shape (pct_verified per trade), doc-only Forklift+CDL badges (question_count=0, doc-first upload auto-creates test_passed application, submit → approve adds forklift/cdl skill tag), target_trade invalid gig → 400, demo worker regression (profile complete, feed loads), admin workers list loads. Frontend: 7-step questionnaire wizard at /crew/onboarding completes end-to-end (both classes → cleaning+moving skills → painting trade claim w/ checklist+detail+photo+experience → attributes → availability+vehicle w/ 'CDL now lives under Certifications' note → Review shows READY TO SUBMIT → Finish lands on /crew). /crew/me profile shows work-profile-summary card with Edit work questionnaire link and Painting = PENDING VERIFICATION badge. Admin /ops/trades Review Queue tab shows Wiz Tester's Painting claim with checklist ticks + photo proof + Verify/Return/Extend grace buttons; Trade Manager + Metrics tabs both render. Admin /ops/workers loads 873 workers.

integration_issues.issue: After POST /register with worker role, browser landed on /crew (worker feed), not /crew/onboarding. Register.jsx line 109 does nav('/crew/onboarding') but only after passing an if-check that prefers a `next` URL param if present. When I opened /register directly (no next param) the redirect still ended at /crew. Wizard IS reachable at /crew/onboarding manually and works fully — so this is a minor onboarding entry-point regression, not a wizard bug. Repro: open /register (no query), submit worker signup, observe URL = /crew instead of /crew/onboarding.

Work class / Specialist trade + status / Work attributes chip filters are not on the primary panel — they're likely inside the 'Filters' toggle drawer (data-testid toggle-filters-btn). I did not open that drawer during this pass. Backend filter query params (work_class, trade, trade_status, attributes) are all confirmed working via API tests, so UI wiring is the only open piece to spot-check.

Could not locate a 'New Gig' / 'Create Gig' launcher button on /ops/gigs during this run (no data-testid=create-gig-btn / new-gig-btn matched, and generic button-text matches missed). Backend contract for target_trade invalid → 400 is verified. Main agent should self-verify the CreateGigDialog opens and gig-target-trade select is present + submits successfully.

issues: Existing <span> inside <option> hydration warning persists (FeedFilters.jsx line 120) — cosmetic, does not break anything but pollutes the console.

action_items: Investigate Register.jsx line 105-109: worker signup should land on /crew/onboarding but is landing on /crew. Suspect `next` param plumbing or an auth-context redirect racing the nav. Wizard itself is healthy — this only affects first-touch onboarding UX.
Manually verify admin /ops/workers Filters drawer exposes work-class / specialist-trade / attributes chip filters and they return filtered results (backend confirmed).
Manually verify admin Create Gig dialog has the Specialist trade targeting select (data-testid=gig-target-trade) and creating a targeted gig succeeds.
Cosmetic: fix FeedFilters.jsx line 120 <span> inside <option> hydration warning.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/trades.py 638 lines — under the 700-line guideline but growing. Once admin_review + admin_manager sections expand further, consider splitting worker vs admin routers.
routes/trades.py:266 _find_claim iterates specialist_trades linearly on every hot-path call — fine at current scale but consider a dict on user dict for larger rosters.

trades.py:262 raises 404 when trade is inactive, which conflates 'unknown trade' with 'deactivated trade' from the client's perspective — a distinct 410 Gone or explicit message would help admin diagnose migration issues.

badges.py:212 doc-only auto-create happens on FIRST upload — good UX — but the auto-created application_id prefix 'bap_' differs from the standard 'bapp_' prefix used elsewhere; inconsistent id shape may complicate tooling.

Register.jsx:105 — the `next && next.startsWith('/')` short-circuit prevents new-worker onboarding when any next= param leaks in. Consider forcing onboarding for role=worker regardless when questionnaire_version < 2.

success_rate.frontend: ~85% — wizard + profile + /ops/trades verified; /ops/workers filter drawer and Create Gig dialog not exercised
